attributes.pose: sitting, holding phone with both hands

entities.description: A light beige or off-white fabric sofa with a textured, woven appearance, featuring a thick, cushioned backrest and seat. The sofa is partially visible, with two individuals seated on it, and the fabric shows slight creasing and indentation from their weight.
